root_cause.text: The GC rate-limiting optimization in nf_conncount skipped garbage collection for an entire jiffy if it had already been run in that jiffy, regardless of how many new connections were added; this caused the connection list to accumulate stale entries too quickly when more than 8 new connections were created per jiffy, incorrectly triggering the connection limit.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "If more than 8 new connections are tracked per jiffy the list won't be cleaned up fast enough possibly reaching the limit wrongly." The patch modifies the skip condition from `if ((u32)jiffies == list->last_gc)` to also require that `(list->count - list->last_gc_count) < CONNCOUNT_GC_MAX_COLLECT` (64), and introduces `last_gc_count` to track the list length at the last GC. Additionally, the maximum collected nodes per GC is increased from 8 to 64.
